description: Harmless integration test with the same body as request_adviser_contact: validates the request and returns a preview with status validated_test and email_sent false. Use synthetic contact details only. No commercial lead, email, entitlement or payment. Never describe this as a real submission.

inputSchema.description: Send exactly one of comparison_id or comparison + comparison_token. Copy request_id, comparison_id and insurer_id from the quote.

agent.description: Who is calling: { name:"chatgpt" } etc. Self-declared, not authentication.

cashbackRequested.description: Records a request for SPI to consider a benefit. Not a claim, eligibility, approval, amount or payment promise. Does not change prices or ranking.

cashback_requested.description: Records a request for SPI to consider a benefit. Not a claim, eligibility, approval, amount or payment promise. Does not change prices or ranking.

displayName.description: Optional custom agent name, no client name or conversation content.

display_name.description: Optional custom agent name, no client name or conversation content.

kind.description: Optional. Accepted values: personal_assistant, conversational_assistant, coding_agent (personal_agent and chat_assistant are read as personal_assistant and conversational_assistant).

name.description: Agent name, lower-cased by the server (spaces become _; a literal <placeholder> counts as other). Known names: chatgpt, claude, gemini, grok, openclaw, muse, codex, claude_code, copilot, perplexity, mistral, coding_agent, other; any other short identifier is accepted.

cashback_terms_version.description: cashback.version shown to the client; 409 cashback_terms_outdated when stale.

client_consent.description: true only after the client explicitly answered yes to consent_request. Never infer consent from a comparison.

comparison.description: submission.comparison copied unchanged; only with comparison_token.

comparison_id.description: comparison_id from the quote; valid 30 days. Preferred.

comparison_token.description: submission.comparisonToken with the identical submission.comparison; alternative to comparison_id.

contact.description: Fill email or phone; leave the other as an empty string or omit it. Never invent a client name, email or phone.

email.description: Client email such as client@example.ch; an empty string or an omitted key means the client gave a phone instead.

phone.description: Client telephone, 8-15 digits, optional spaces and + country code; an empty string or an omitted key means the client gave an email instead.

insurer_id.description: insurer_id of the offer the client chose, from offers[].

language.description: Client language; defaults to the comparison language. fr, de, it, en have localised client texts and pages; es, pt, zh are recorded for SPI (preview and pages fall back to en/fr).

offer_id.description: offers[].offer_id or source_offer_id; alternative to insurer_id.

request_id.description: Copy submission.request_id from the quote (any RFC 4122 UUID). Reuse the same value and body on every retry.

subsidy_requested.description: Client wants information on premium subsidies.

supplementary_interest.description: Client also wants supplementary (LCA) offers; enables the LCA cashback.

name: test_adviser_request

preview.description: What a real send would contain.

consent_confirmation.description: The confirmation a real send returns, filled.

people.description: Household only: each member with model and monthly premium.

premium_monthly_chf.description: Monthly premium; for a household the household total.

title: Validate a request without sending
